subject: Using dependent files in rmd outputs

messages.author: 39cf519319a160c5
messages.subject: Using dependent files in rmd outputs
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to do two things with Rmarkdown documents and outputs in Shinyapps.io

1. Use dependent files in the Rmd document. 

I am trying to use additional files which include a .csv and .css file for the Rmarkdown but when I call it in the Shinyapps.io, it says it does not exist. My file paths are 
css: './rmd/styles.css
logos <- read.csv('./rmd/logos.csv')
Both locations are relative to the directory of the .Rmd file 

2. Setting file location of the Rmd document

For organizational purposes, I want to create a folder in my app directory with all my rmd files. When I put this in my download handler it throws back an error saying the file does not exist.
I am using the file path relative to the App -> (./rmd/report.Rmd)

When I just put the Rmd file in the same path as my server and ui file, it will work


output$bidownload <- downloadHandler(
  
  function(){
      filename = paste0(input$conreport, '.html')
  },
  content = function(file) {
    
    tempReport <- file.path(tempdir(), paste0('./rmd/', input$conreport, '.Rmd'))
    file.copy(paste0('./rmd/', input$conreport, '.Rmd'), tempReport, overwrite = TRUE)
      
      # Set up parameters to pass to Rmd document
    params <- list(range = as.character(input$dateparam), local = local)
      
      
    rmarkdown::render(tempReport, output_file = file,
                        params = params,
                        envir = new.env(parent = globalenv())
      )
    
  }
)
